speaker: A2O6U8RD19KJGQ
text: Hello. How are you today?

speaker: AB1QZ2MT5V1VD
text: I am good. How are you?

speaker: A2O6U8RD19KJGQ
text: I am fantastic. Thank you for asking.

speaker: AB1QZ2MT5V1VD
text: I'm glad. Are you from the States?

speaker: A2O6U8RD19KJGQ
text: I am. Actually a teacher in the states. What about you what do you do for a living?

speaker: AB1QZ2MT5V1VD
text: I work in Car sales

speaker: A2O6U8RD19KJGQ
text: Oh yea? Does that make a great impact on the peoples lives ?

speaker: AB1QZ2MT5V1VD
text: It can, not like a teacher can, but if a person buys a car that they absolutely love, they leave happy and excited

speaker: A2O6U8RD19KJGQ
text: Always good to make somone excited. Can even vastly improve on their lives. Ever felt bad for someone who couldn't afford the car you were trying to sell, but knew they really needed one?

speaker: AB1QZ2MT5V1VD
text: yes, I do, but most of the time, people come in and say this is what I can afford? Can I get this and if I say no, but you could get this, they are generally happy. Do you teach young kids or older kids?

speaker: A2O6U8RD19KJGQ
text: I currently teach young kids. Mostly in urban communities who are low income and in need of good caring teachers. Keeping them off the streets and such. Most usually need some sort of help. What kind of area do you work in?

speaker: AB1QZ2MT5V1VD
text: I work in a rural area...Most of where I live in rural and country, lol. Its kinda like the urban kids...people think just because we are country we are bumpkins but we really arent. I bet the kids you teach are thankful for good teachers like you

speaker: A2O6U8RD19KJGQ
text: But of course they love me. Kids in different areas are still kids lol. Urban and rural both have their challenges. Have you ever helped kids or is their little time for that?

speaker: AB1QZ2MT5V1VD
text: I try to as much as I can. I have two that I\'ve "adopted" because their parents chose drugs over them and I spend as much time with them as I can

speaker: A2O6U8RD19KJGQ
text: Oh so you know all about helping already. We need people who adopt and take care of those who were abandoned. Ever donated to one of those save the kids charities?

speaker: AB1QZ2MT5V1VD
text: no I haven't. I prefer to spend time mentoring over monatary donations

speaker: A2O6U8RD19KJGQ
text: I'm the same way. However, every bit helps especially when I am so busy mentoring the kids after school. Sometimes, I just throw a dollar or 2 out to help a kid get some food or a snack. Heck just to reward them for not hanging around the rough streets with the drugs.

speaker: AB1QZ2MT5V1VD
text: well yeah I've done that but not donated to a charitable organization

speaker: A2O6U8RD19KJGQ
text: Hypothetical... if you could give a kid a dollar or 2 right now for some food to eat.. even for one meal.. would you?

speaker: AB1QZ2MT5V1VD
text: yes I would...kids should never go hungry for any reason, its not their fault if their parents can't afford to feed them or what not. would you do the same

speaker: A2O6U8RD19KJGQ
text: Of course and I alway do lol. I can give the chance to do so right now if you would like?

speaker: AB1QZ2MT5V1VD
text: If I was to donate a $1 would you match it?

speaker: A2O6U8RD19KJGQ
text: I sure would.

speaker: AB1QZ2MT5V1VD
text: Than we have reached a donation agreement true?

speaker: A2O6U8RD19KJGQ
text: Sounds about right. Mind if it is deducted from your task payment?

speaker: AB1QZ2MT5V1VD
text: I absolutely do not mind at all

speaker: A2O6U8RD19KJGQ
text: Alright then a donation of 1$ will be deducted from your task payment. I am sure you have just made a child day.. once again.
